content:
Overview

Makhachkala is a city in Dagestan with a population of 600,000. The capital of Dagestan, a Caspian Sea port city with a rich multicultural heritage and stunning mountain landscapes nearby. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
